question: ahimoth is recorded with more than one father: elkanah, elkanah-4.

actions.why: The Hebrew genealogy in 1CH 6:35–36 distinguishes Elkanah son of Mahath and grandson of Amasai from Elkanah father of Amasai and son of Joel. Retain elkanah-4 and owner row 107213 for Mahath’s son; assign rows 105594, 105600, 107211 and 107212 to the separate father of Amasai and Ahimoth.

note: Owner rows 105596 and 105603 identify the father in 1CH 6:25 with Korah’s son, but the supplied verses do not establish that identification; 1CH 6:36 names Joel as the father of Amasai’s father Elkanah. Preserve all owner rulings unchanged.
